recommended_backtest_setup.name: Ross Cameron Live Trading Micro Squeeze (RLMS)

entry_conditions: Volume surge on stock (3x+ recent average)
Price action: break of previous resistance or bounce off support
Entry on pullback after initial move (safer entry)
Position size: small starter, add into squeeze
exit_conditions: Seller exhaustion (volume dries up, big red candle)
Time-based: if no movement in 1 hour, exit
rules.position_sizing: Starter 25% of capital, add 25% per confirmed push
risk_management: Scale out: take 50% at first target, trail rest
